name: Ng Wing Shing
source:
"Heh, I'm a baby compared to you cyber-warriors."

Ng Wing Shing is a high-ranking member of the Qingyun Society, and [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url]'s right-hand man, acting as the president of Shanghai Cybernetics. Ng is a legendary hacker and programmer known as the "All-Consuming Poison" for the deadly cyber virus he developed in his youth, which is still roaming the net and evolving. Ng is a hardcore gynoid doll lover and collector, spending his free time designing and dressing up gynoids.

One of the five responsible for [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]'s rape and murder.
